m1_native.environment: Apple M1, macOS 26.5.2, Apple Clang 21.0.0, 8 physical and 8 logical CPUs
m1_native.label: native hardware, scheduler-managed placement

linux_arm64_vm.environment: Lima Apple Virtualization VM, Ubuntu kernel 7.0.0-28-generic, GCC 15.2.0, 4 vCPUs
linux_arm64_vm.label: virtualized functional and scheduler evidence only

limitations: The native M1 host was loaded during the pilot, so its large sample spread makes the padding effect exploratory.
The Linux result is virtualized and has no SMT or cross-package topology, so it cannot establish physical-cache or NUMA causality.
No x86-64 performance sample was collected.
No perf counters were available, so retry counts and process rusage are not a decomposition into instructions, cache misses, or migrations.
